title: Aerobic System
welcome_lead: Beyond 2 minutes — Krebs cycle and ETC power endurance.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on aerobic ATP production and energy system interplay.
final_note: Aerobic system is slowest to start but practically inexhaustible — endurance's engine.

concepts.def: Mitochondrial ATP production using O₂; ~32 ATP per glucose.
Mitochondrial matrix cycle producing CO₂, NADH, FADH₂, GTP.
Inner mitochondrial membrane; drives oxidative phosphorylation.
Fatty acid breakdown to acetyl-CoA in mitochondria.
Common entry point from carbs and fats into Krebs cycle.

walkthroughs.body_html: Glycolysis → pyruvate → acetyl-CoA → Krebs → ETC. Net ~32 ATP per glucose; ~10× anaerobic yield.
Trained endurance athletes oxidise more fat at given workload, sparing limited glycogen.
No clean switch — all three systems contribute simultaneously, proportions shifting with intensity and duration.
